items.title: Why reviewing AI-generated code is devilishly hard
items.raw_excerpt: Hereâs the thing: when working on code with GenAI assistance (from a chat-bot, through IDE auto-completion, or, increasingly, with an AI agent) you need a better understanding of the system than when working without. items.title: 独家丨前美团外卖技术负责人入局餐饮具身模型，「元节智能」获千万级种子轮融资
items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网独家获悉，具身智能初创公司「元节智能（AtomBite.AI）」已于近期完成千万级种子轮融资。本轮由英诺科创基金领投，水木清华校友种子基金、知名投资人个人跟投。据悉，本轮融资将主要用于餐饮场景具身世界模型研发、核心产品打磨及落地。 今年3月底元节智能才在苏州注册成立，成立不到两个月即完成首轮融资，同时已获得了国内外多家头部公司产品合作部署意向。据了解，企业核心团队汇聚了来自清华、中科大、美团、地平线等顶尖高校与科技公司的研发负责人及精锐人才，团队背景实力雄厚。   01 清华博士+美团产研班底   元节智能创始人兼CEO王栋博士师从中国人工智能泰斗、清华大学张钹院士，深耕人工智能领域十余年，兼具算法研究与商业场景落地的经验。   学术上，王栋在博士期间深耕人工智能表示问题，并在AI与机器人领域顶会持续发表高水平论文。2011年，他搭建出全球首个商用视频人脸识别与跟踪系统；此后，他又构建出业界领先的本地生活服务推荐系统及移动原生广告平台，将前沿的AI技术与复杂的商业场景深度融合。   联合创始人李滔曾执掌美团外卖算法与数据体系，是少数真正跑通“全链路数据算法驱动”的实战型技术负责人；同为联创的李浩哲为连续创业者，具备多年全球化商业落地能力，为团队注入强大的商业化基因。   王栋身上最核心的标签，是前美团外卖事业部技术负责人。在美团期间，他长期管理千人产研团队，主导构建了支撑日均数千万订单的外卖算法、数据与系统架构。十年外卖一线的实战，让他对餐饮外卖场景的商家痛点、运营链路与规模化路径有着深刻的理解，并曾针对商家痛点研制过多款智能硬件产品成功部署。王栋的背景，让元节智能在出发的第一天就具备了极强的产业体感。   离开美团后，王栋在北美与新加坡进行了多轮的持续数月的市场考察，走访大量餐饮商家，调研各方

excerpt_i18n.en:
Lei Feng exclusively learned that embodied intelligence startup AtomBite.AI has recently completed a multi-million yuan seed round of financing. This round was led by Inno Science and Technology Innovation Fund, with follow-on investments from Tsinghua SEM Alumni Seed Fund and well-known individual investors. The funds will primarily be used for developing embodied world models for dining scenarios, refining core products, and deployment.  

AtomBite.AI was registered and established in Suzhou at the end of March this year, completing its first financing round in less than two months. It has already secured product collaboration and deployment intentions from leading domestic and international companies. The core team includes R&D leaders and top talents from prestigious universities and tech companies such as Tsinghua University, USTC, Meituan, and Horizon Robotics, boasting a strong team background.  

### 01 Tsinghua PhD + Meituan R&D Team  

Dr. Wang Dong, founder and CEO of AtomBite.AI, studied under China's AI pioneer, Academician Zhang Bo of Tsinghua University. With over a decade of experience in AI, he combines algorithm research with commercial application expertise.  

Academically, Dr. Wang focused on AI representation during his PhD and has consistently published high-level papers at top AI and robotics conferences. In 2011, he built the world's first commercial video facial recognition and tracking system. Later, he developed industry-leading local life service recommendation systems and mobile native advertising platforms, deeply integrating cutting-edge AI with complex commercial scenarios.  

Co-founder Li Tao previously led Meituan's food delivery algorithm and data systems.
excerpt_i18n.es: Lei Feng Net ha sabido en exclusiva que la startup de inteligencia encarnada "AtomBite.AI" ha completado recientemente una ronda de financiación semilla de varios millones de yuanes. Esta ronda ha sido liderada por Inno Science and Technology Innovation Fund, con la participación del fondo de semillas de antiguos alumnos de Tsinghua Shuimu y un inversor particular conocido. Según se informa, los fondos se destinarán principalmente al desarrollo del modelo de mundo encarnado para el sector de la restauración, el pulido del producto principal y su implementación. AtomBite.AI se registró y fundó en Suzhou a finales de marzo de este año, y en menos de dos meses completó su primera ronda de financiación, además de haber obtenido intenciones de cooperación para el despliegue de productos de varias empresas líderes nacionales e internacionales. Se sabe que el equipo central de la empresa está formado por profesionales de universidades y empresas tecnológicas de primer nivel como Tsinghua, la Universidad de Ciencia y Tecnología de China, Meituan y Horizon Robotics.

items.title: 寻找 AI 的「第三语言」：中间表示如何打通多模态鸿沟 ｜ CVPR 2026
items.raw_excerpt: “请把杯子拿起来”。 这句话对你来说轻而易举。因为你看到了杯子，理解了“拿起来”的含义，手自然地伸过去、捏住、提起。但对一个 AI 系统来说，这中间隔着数道几乎不可逾越的鸿沟：语言到动作、动作到视觉、视觉到空间、空间到执行。 传统做法是强迫模型学会直接映射，通过输入一段文字或一组动作参数，让其直接输出像素级的视频帧或关节角度。这种方法在受限环境和充足标注数据下勉强可行，但一旦面对真实世界的复杂性，系统就会崩溃，因为鸿沟太宽，直接跨越注定失败。 清华大学智能产业研究院赵昊团队在 CVPR 2026 发表的四篇论文，共享着同一个设计哲学： 当两种模态之间的鸿沟太大，真正的解法是为它们搭桥，找到一种“第三语言”。这个“第三语言”，就是中间表示。 这四篇论文分别从动作到视频、图像到 4D 场景、首帧到未来视频、异构硬件到统一策略四个不同的角度，验证了同一个核心假设： 引入合适的中间表示，比强迫模型学会直接映射更有效。 01 ORV： 当机器人看视频时，它在看什么？ 机器人学习领域有一个看似简单却长期未能很好解决的问题：如何让机器人通过观看人类操作视频来学习新技能？ 这个问题的困难程度远超想象。对人类来说直观的东西，对机器人来说却是无法理解的数据流，因为视频是一帧帧像素，动作是七维或更高维的连续控制信号，这两种表示之间存在巨大的“表征鸿沟”。 现有的机器人视频生成方法通常采用端到端的方式：输入动作序列，直接输出对应的视频帧。这种做法在实践中面临两个根本性问题： 动作空间和像素空间的结构差异太大， 动作是低维的连续向量，像素是高维的离散网格，强行让模型学习从前者到后者的直接映射，就像让一个只会说中文的人直接听懂法语，中间没有任何翻译。 缺乏结构化约束 ：生成的视频往往在多视角一致性上表现糟糕。同一个动作从两个不同视角看，本应是同一个 3D 事件的不同投影，但端到端模型经常会生成两个视角

excerpt_i18n.en: "Please pick up the cup." This instruction is effortless for you. You see the cup, understand the meaning of "pick up," and your hand naturally reaches out, grasps, and lifts it. But for an AI system, this involves several nearly insurmountable gaps: from language to action, action to vision, vision to space, and space to execution. The traditional approach forces the model to learn direct mapping by inputting a piece of text or a set of action parameters, outputting pixel-level video frames or joint angles directly. This method barely works in constrained environments with sufficient annotated data, but when faced with the complexity of the real world, the system collapses because the gaps are too wide, and direct bridging is doomed to fail. The team led by Zhao Hao at the Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR), Tsinghua University, published four papers at CVPR 2026, all sharing the same design philosophy: When the gap between two modalities is too large, the real solution is to build a bridge for them, finding a "third language." This "third language" is the intermediate representation. These four papers validate the same core hypothesis from four different perspectives: from action to video, image to 4D scene, first frame to future video, and heterogeneous hardware to unified policy. Introducing an appropriate intermediate representation is more effective than forcing the model to learn direct mapping. 01 ORV: When a robot watches a video, what does it see? In the field of robot learning, there is a seemingly simple yet long-standing unresolved problem: how to enable robots to learn new skills by watching videos of human operations? The difficulty of this problem far exceeds imagination.
excerpt_i18n.es: "Por favor, levanta la taza". Esta frase te resulta sencilla. Porque ves la taza, entiendes el significado de "levantar", y tu mano se extiende de forma natural, la agarra y la eleva. Pero para un sistema de IA, entre medias hay varias brechas casi insalvables: del lenguaje a la acción, de la acción a la visión, de la visión al espacio, del espacio a la ejecución. El enfoque tradicional obliga al modelo a aprender un mapeo directo, introduciendo un texto o un conjunto de parámetros de acción para que genere directamente fotogramas de video a nivel de píxeles o ángulos articulares. Este método funciona a duras penas en entornos controlados y con datos etiquetados suficientes, pero al enfrentarse a la complejidad del mundo real, el sistema colapsa, porque la brecha es demasiado amplia y cruzarla directamente está condenado al fracaso.

excerpt_i18n.en: Google I/O has always been the most information-dense node on the global developer calendar and the ultimate stage for tech giants to showcase their AI ambitions. On May 19, 2026, in Mountain View, California, Sundar Pichai unveiled 16 core product updates in just two hours. Among them, five products each boast 3 billion users, the Gemini assistant has 900 million users, and Search AI Mode, launched only a year ago, has surpassed 1 billion monthly active users. There was no "One More Thing" suspense, no deliberately saved blockbuster finale. Google opted for a near-bombardment information release strategy: laying everything on the table at once. On stage, Pichai made a thought-provoking remark: "The most cutting-edge agents may have only reached 0.1% of the world's population. The real question is how to scale this frontier capability to truly broader users." The subtext was clear: agents today are still toys for a niche group of geeks and high-end enterprises, but Google aims to turn them into a daily reality for 3 billion people. Google I/O 2026 Release List (Partial) Details link: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/google-io-20
excerpt_i18n.es: Google I/O siempre ha sido el punto de información más denso en el calendario global de desarrolladores, y también el escenario máximo donde los gigantes tecnológicos proclaman sus ambiciones en IA. El 19 de mayo de 2026, en Mountain View, California, Sundar Pichai lanzó 16 actualizaciones de productos principales en dos horas. Entre ellas, cinco productos cuentan con 3 mil millones de usuarios cada uno, el asistente Gemini tiene 900 millones de usuarios, y el modo AI de búsqueda, lanzado hace solo un año, superó los mil millones de usuarios activos mensuales. Sin el ritmo de suspense de "One More Thing", sin un huevo de pascua impactante guardado para el final. Google optó por un enfoque casi de bombardeo.

items.raw_excerpt: Streaming vision-language models (VLMs) continuously generate responses given an instruction prompt and an online stream of input frames. This is a core mechanism for real-time visual assistants. Existing VLM frameworks predominantly assess models in offline settings. In contrast, the performance of a streaming VLM depends on additional metrics beyond pure video understanding, including proactiveness, which reflects the timeliness of the model’s responses, and consistency, which captures the robustness of its responses over time.
